units.source_text: 我和所有这一切都隔绝了。

en.t: I was cut off from all of it.

units.source_text: 我没有钱，没有自由，也没有解放。

en.t: I had no money, no freedom, and no liberation either.

units.source_text: 但是，当我说出"新时代"的时候，

en.t: But when I uttered the words "new age,"

units.source_text: 好岁的我尽管还未能形成清晰的形状，

en.t: although the self I was at that age had not yet taken on any clear shape,

units.source_text: 但我已下定某种决心，则是千真万确的。

en.t: it was absolutely true that I had already made some kind of resolve.
